senses.gloss:
संलक्ष् €10 U.
—1 To observe, perceive, see, notice; आश्चर्यदर्शनः संलक्ष्यते मनुष्यलोकः
 Ś. 7; संलक्ष्यते न च्छिदुरोऽपि हारः R. 16. 62 ‘is not noticed or known’; 8. 42.
—2 To test, prove, determine; हेम्नः संलक्ष्यते ह्यग्नौ विशुद्धिः श्यामिकापि वा R. 1. 10.
—3 To hear, learn, understand.
—4 To characterize, distinguish.

संलग्न p. p.
—1 Closely attached, stuck together, united with, adhering to.
—2 Come to blows or close contest.

संलप् €1 P.
—1 To talk, converse; संलपतो जनसमाजात् Dk.
—2 To name, call.

—1 Conversation, chat, discourse.
—2 Especially familiar or confidential talk, secret conversation.
—3 (In dramas) A kind of dialogue; संलापः स्याद्गभीरोक्तिर्नानाभावसमाश्रया S. D. 6. 131.

संलापकः^1 m.^2 A kind of minor drama, said to be of a controversial
 kind; see S. D. 6-291.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/8ab1240.
[2] Correction submitted by on 20260501. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/174.

संलिख् €6 P.
—1 To scratch, scrape.
—2 To write, inscribe.
—3 To play upon (a musical instrument).
संलीढ p. p. Licked up; enjoyed, tasted.

संली €4 Ā.
—1 To cling, adhere or stick to.
—2 To lie down or settle upon, alight.
—3 To lurk.
—4 To melt away.
—5 To go or enter into.

—1 Lying down, sleep.
—2 Dissolution.
—3 Universal destruction (प्रलय).
—4 A nest; विश्रान्तः संहत्य पक्षौ संलयायैव ध्रियते Bṛ. Up. 4. 3. 19.

—1 Adhering or clinging to.
—2 Dissolution.
—3 Lying down, sleep.

संलीन p. p.
—1 Clung, adhered to.
—2 Joined together.
—3 Hidden, concealed.
—4 Cowering down.
—5 Contracted, shrunk.
.━{@Comp.@}: संलीनकर्ण, संलीनमानस
संलीन + -कर्ण a. with the ears hanging down.
संलीन + -मानस a. depressed in mind, in drooping spirits.

संलुड् €1 P. To stir, agitate.
—10 U. or Caus.
—1 To shake, stir about, move to and fro; यत्र संलोडिता लुब्धैः प्रायशो
 धर्मसेतवः Mb. 12. 287. 44.
—2 To confound, disturb, perplex.

संलुलित a.
—1 Agitated, confused; Rām.
—2 Come into contact with; C. P.
